title: fix: accept repository image URLs in app submissions
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: App submissions now accept raw GitHub repository image URLs as well as GitHub issue attachments, fixing the false missing-image result in #17053. A 16:9 image is recommended but no longer required: portrait, square, and smaller images can be submitted, and catalog publishing still resizes or crops them to 1280×720. Images must remain readable PNG, JPEG, or WebP files no larger than 5 MB. General non-GitHub image URLs are not supported. Nineteen tests pass, including conversion cases for portrait, square, and small images.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, Polli checks a repository image on a retro monitor beside a lime green (#ecf874) flower pot, while a tidy row of differently shaped picture frames waits to be cropped. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears tiny editor glasses, stays small within the scene, and is strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
